head: de6a9bdbc0100ac778dff1ad48ab2f732b7d181e
reviewer_scope: public package exports and independent compound-patch consumers

findings.claim: Wire compound-patch validation into renderer streaming hooks before making path writes reject malformed tokens
findings.observed: Built React useUIStream accepts a JSONL move from /state/source to /state/items/01, removes source, and silently rejects the destination. A malformed copy/move source inserts an own undefined property. Core compileSpecStream rejects the same malformed compound patches and preserves the source.
findings.recommendation: Apply the guarded compound semantics at each renderer stream dispatcher or delegate them to a shared helper, then exercise the built hook with invalid source and destination streams.
findings.base_comparison: Confirmed with built base core and identical built React hook; coordinator/hook-proof-base-public.json. Base moves the value into index 1 for malformed destination 01, whereas head drops it entirely. Base reads index 1 for malformed copy/move sources, whereas head inserts undefined. Valid move output is identical between base and head.

notes: Core ESM and CJS were imported by absolute built-artifact path.
Official Redux, Zustand, Jotai, and XState adapters were read and delegate their writes to createStoreAdapter; no additional independent immutable setter found.
